## 2026-10-27

### Burgers reconstruction screen — final accepted report and closeout (Codex coordinator)
- Final bounded screen and [single question report](reports/2026-10-27-burgers-reconstruction/2026-10-27-burgers-same-sample-reconstruction.md) accepted. Both immutable validation exports, the report generator and auxiliary POD diagnostics are bound by `ACCEPTED-SCREEN.json`. Independent Codex rechecked every retained result, coefficient/timing linkage, representative fits/fields, frozen choices, full-cohort reporting, figure points and durable retention. Claude successfully reviewed the proposal and report logic; it did not provide the independent empirical GPU-result audit.
- Primary actual-coarse comparison: 2D ratio of cohort medians 1.39088391781, 0 wins / 0 ties / 32 losses across 32 cases; 3D ratio 1.21866843603, 2 wins / 0 ties / 62 losses across 64 cases. Both fail the prespecified expansion criteria, including the worst-error condition. All primary paired classifications are unchanged under the retained coarse-time perturbation.
- The report also preserves fixed linear/cubic/full-sine comparisons, continuous/interpolated POD with its information and approximation qualifications, the fixed 2D rank/ridge coarse-training control, same-map A/B comparisons, observability/amplification, fine-target oracle limits and same-invocation warm fitting/decoding costs. The current bank representation has a measurable floor even under fine-target fitting; no causal scalar error decomposition or general architecture conclusion is claimed.
- Complete ledger: 5211 conservatively charged seconds for 2D and 5039 for 3D; total 2.847222222 GPU-hours. Slurm accounting is saved in `audits/SACCT-CLOSEOUT.txt` and generated `GPU-LEDGER.json`. The earlier cancelled development retains its conservative charge.
- Retractions/corrections remain explicit: the initial 2D filename-collision run is scientifically invalid and preserved for audit; no result from it enters the report. The first 2D closeout had only ignored expanded copies. Independent retention review caught this, and all run evidence was subsequently committed as direct Git blobs, with member manifests and lossless complete exports mirrored. No numerical result changed during the retention repair.
- 2D final retention: `d3773aabc33ff8a7bd07c0d3df23768066017f04`, mirror `2686da8125cc549b381cc7b9ea29cd4279043503`. 3D final retention: `d7e21d00e`, mirror `6221252fb`. All owned remote job directories are empty after verified collection; local expanded files and Git evidence remain. The canonical log preserves all earlier approval, review, failure and repair chronology.
- No more runs are required for the approved screen. Dynamics, new neural training, larger campaigns and sealed/OOD cohorts remain outside this completed work. Coordinator and dimensional branches remain unmerged; the user must choose whether to consolidate the three experiment worktrees.
